Maya: quick PM follow-up from the postmortem: noisy pages from inference autoscaler continuing. want a short action list & owners by EOD.
Ravi: i'll take suppression rule updates (suppress after 3 repeats in 5m). will open PR and canary to staging.
Liam: i'll change dedupe key to include cluster_id and extend window to 10m. will roll region-by-region.
Sara: i'll add a metric guard (only page if error_rate >5% for two consecutive 1m windows) and a playbook note on un-silence.
Maya: thanks. list ETAs here so PM can track.
Ravi: action: suppress policy update (owner: Ravi) ETA: 2025-03-12 18:00 UTC PR: https://git.internal/rw/ops/1212
Liam: action: alert-router dedupe + window (owner: Liam) ETA: 2025-03-12 16:00 UTC PR: https://git.internal/rw/router/1313
Sara: action: metric guard + playbook (owner: Sara) ETA: 2025-03-13 12:00 UTC PR: https://git.internal/rw/monitoring/1414
Maya: we'll tag future pages with "inference-noise" and run weekly sweeps for 4 weeks. owner for sweep: Maya/SRE rotation.
Liam: note: initial canary may still generate pages because old dedupe buckets won't match; expect small burst.
Ravi: opened PR and canary to us-west-2, added smoke checks.
Sara: added playbook snippet and rollback steps in PR description.
Maya: i'll close this follow-up after both PRs merged and 2 weeks of reduced paging. ping here with any regressions. :white_check_mark:
